related.title: IEEE 1588 PTP：四時間戳偏移估計
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學30 s後保留至少5000 bits；800/s通過、1200/s不足；長時間負淨產率仍會耗盡，需限流或擴充。 key_pool_ledger.csv、無金鑰素材的ID對帳與耗盡預測 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 16000 與變更 4000 bits、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching reserve after30 s is5000 bits:800/s passes and1200/s fails; sustained negative balance eventually empties the pool and requires throttling or more supply. key_pool_ledger.csv, key-material-free ID accounting and depletion forecast Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 16000 and changed 4000 bits, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學偏移絕對值需不大於5 µs；4通過、10失敗；同時記錄對稱性假設的未決誤差。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching absolute offset limit5 microseconds:4 passes and10 fails; retain unresolved error from the symmetry assumption.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成池10000 bits，產生1000 bits/s、使用800 bits/s，觀察30 s；擾動使用1200 bits/s。 名義式 10000+(1000-800)*30 = 16000 bits；變更式 10000+(1000-1200)*30 = 4000 bits。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 逐秒更新30次與閉式相符；確認每份已交付key ID不重複使用，且紀錄只有長度、時間與ID雜湊。
合成正向戳差24 µs、反向16 µs；時鐘變更後正向30、反向10 µs，平均路徑延遲均20 µs。 名義式 (24-16)/2 = 4 us；變更式 (30-10)/2 = 10 us。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 先以兩差相加/2求路徑延遲，再用正向差減延遲回算偏移；補償後正反差均應為20。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic pool10000 bits with production1000 bits/s and consumption800 bits/s over30 s; change consumption to1200 bits/s. Nominal 10000+(1000-800)*30 = 16000 bits; changed 10000+(1000-1200)*30 = 4000 bits. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Update one second at a time and compare the closed form; confirm delivered key IDs are not reused and logs contain length, time and ID hashes only.

Synthetic forward timestamp difference24 microseconds and reverse16; after a clock change use30 and10, retaining20 microseconds mean path delay. Nominal (24-16)/2 = 4 us; changed (30-10)/2 = 10 us. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: First average both differences to estimate delay, then subtract delay from the forward difference; corrected forward/reverse differences should both be20.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: IEEE 802.1Qch：循環佇列的逐跳週期
related.titleEn: IEEE 802.1Qch: per-hop cycles in cyclic queuing
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學30 s後保留至少5000 bits；800/s通過、1200/s不足；長時間負淨產率仍會耗盡，需限流或擴充。 key_pool_ledger.csv、無金鑰素材的ID對帳與耗盡預測 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 16000 與變更 4000 bits、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。

related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學管線部分預算500 µs；3跳通過、5跳失敗；未建模的注入相位與傳播不能當作0交付正式保證。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching pipeline budget500 microseconds:3 hops pass and5 fail; omitted injection phase and propagation cannot be treated as zero in a formal guarantee.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成池10000 bits，產生1000 bits/s、使用800 bits/s，觀察30 s；擾動使用1200 bits/s。 名義式 10000+(1000-800)*30 = 16000 bits；變更式 10000+(1000-1200)*30 = 4000 bits。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 逐秒更新30次與閉式相符；確認每份已交付key ID不重複使用，且紀錄只有長度、時間與ID雜湊。
合成週期125 µs，3跳；擾動5跳，假設每週期容量充足且相位已對齊。 名義式 3*125 = 375 us；變更式 5*125 = 625 us。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 以封包在週期0入站，逐跳列下一週期出站索引1、2、3；5跳延伸到5，檢查不能跳過一個切換週期。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic pool10000 bits with production1000 bits/s and consumption800 bits/s over30 s; change consumption to1200 bits/s. Nominal 10000+(1000-800)*30 = 16000 bits; changed 10000+(1000-1200)*30 = 4000 bits. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Update one second at a time and compare the closed form; confirm delivered key IDs are not reused and logs contain length, time and ID hashes only.

Synthetic125 microsecond cycles and3 hops, changed to5, assuming sufficient per-cycle capacity and aligned phase. Nominal 3*125 = 375 us; changed 5*125 = 625 us. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Enter a packet at cycle0 and list egress indices1,2,3, extending to5 for five hops; verify no queue-switch cycle is omitted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
